darwin.notes: macOS 1.2.5 build 136: adds three Loop Tools in each Live Preview with independent playback, upper/lower controls, and easier moving and resizing. REC can record the app's playback mix to WAV. Instructions text can be selected and copied, and the complete guide can be exported as a printable PDF. Portable library indexes now sync incrementally; per-library full-scan time tracks active indexing and audio analysis. Includes preview, pitch and selection fixes.

win32.notes: Windows 1.2.5 build 378: new libraries start folder-only analysis while the global backlog stays paused; imported analysis is retained. Folder-only full-scan time excludes pauses. Removing a library immediately refreshes ALL SAMPLES. Sample Grid's ALL SAMPLES scope includes every indexed library. OFF-LINE appears only when relevant; offline samples are hidden by default and can be shown for inspection without playback or file actions until the library reconnects.
